{{Short description|None}}
The '''2025 Copa Sudamericana first stage''' was played from 4 to 6 March 2025.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/calendario-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Protegido: Calendario de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=18 September 2024|access-date=1 November 2024|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lavoz.com.ar/deportes/futbol/conmebol-publico-el-calendario-2025-cuando-arranca-la-copa-libertadores-para-talleres/|title=Conmebol publicó el calendario 2025: cuándo arranca la Copa Libertadores para Talleres|trans-title=Conmebol published the 2025 calendar: when does the Copa Libertadores start for Talleres?|publisher=[[La Voz del Interior]]|date=13 December 2024|access-date=15 December 2024|language=es}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the first stage to decide 16 of the 32 places in the [[2025 Copa Sudamericana group stage|group stage]] of the [[2025 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CS-2025-ESP-Digital.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|trans-title=2025 CONMEBOL Sudamericana Clubs Handbook|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=12 December 2024|access-date=20 December 2024|language=es}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the first stage was held on 19 December 2024, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lanacion.com.ar/deportes/futbol/cuando-es-el-sorteo-de-la-copa-libertadores-2025-nid16122024/|title=Cuándo es el sorteo de la Copa Libertadores 2025|trans-title=When is the draw for the 2025 Copa Libertadores|publisher=[[La Nación]]|language=es|date=16 December 2024|access-date=17 December 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/enfrentamientos-en-la-fase-preliminar-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Enfrentamientos en la Fase Preliminar de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|trans-title=Matchups in the Preliminary Stage of the 2025 CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=19 December 2024|access-date=20 December 2024|language=es}}</ref>

For the first stage, the 32 teams involved were divided into eight pots according to their national association. The 32 teams were drawn into 16 ties, with the four teams from each national association being drawn against a rival from the same association in two ties per association. The first team drawn in each tie hosted the match.<ref name="draw procedure">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/pautas-de-sorteo-para-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Pautas de sorteo para la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|trans-title=Draw guidelines for the 2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=10 December 2024|access-date=16 December 2024}}</ref><section end=Draw />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the first stage, each tie was played on a [[Single-elimination tournament|single-leg]] basis, with the winner being decided in a [[penalty shoot-out]] in case of a draw after 90 minutes.<ref name="regulations"/>

The 16 winners of the first stage advanced to the [[2025 Copa Sudamericana group stage|group stage]] to join the 12 teams directly qualified for that stage (six from Argentina and six from Brazil), and four teams transferred from the [[2025 Copa Libertadores|Copa Libertadores]] (the four teams eliminated in the [[2025 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages#Third stage|third stage of qualifying]]).<section end=Format />

==Matches==
Matches were played on 4–6 March 2025.<ref name="fixture_pdf">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Fixture_CONMEBOL-Sudamericana-2025_Primera-Fase.pdf|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA 2025 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión de 19/12/2024|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=20 December 2024|access-date=20 December 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/fixture-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Fixture de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=25 February 2025|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Fixture_CONMEBOL-Sudamericana-2025_Primera-Fase_v25.02.pdf|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA 2025 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión de 25/2/2025|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=25 February 2025|access-date=26 February 2025}}</ref>
